name: Source clip-pairing sensitivity screen

screen.rule: At least one fixed view must meet cross-user flip>=5% AND cross-minus-same-user flip>=2pp in BOTH seeds in >=4/6 trajectories. Gate is a resource screen, not a statistical claim. Failure stops this cross-user pairing candidate without threshold/seed/view grid.

readouts: user-balanced class-balanced flip, JS and source CE delta; all full training pools only
controls: single view replacement; same-class same-user derangement versus same-class different-user bijection; identity and joint three-view reorder
limits: No new training or held-user scoring.
Source in-sample sensitivity is not generalization gain or causal user-style evidence.
Synthetic cross-user clips may be physically inconsistent; class preservation alone does not validate augmentation.
Six heavily reused development users, single training seed, two fixed permutation repetitions.
No verified frame timestamps; instance pairing only.
Even a passed screen requires separately frozen source pilot and matched augmentation controls, literature/novelty still unvalidated.
